original_bugs: Bug 1: Winner detection query used top-level lottery_id and numbers fields, but multi-play tickets store these inside the plays[] array
Bug 2: Mark-as-lost step was marking ALL pending tickets as lost including multi-play ones whose other lotteries hadn't drawn yet
Bug 3: Pale/tripleta winning logic wasn't checking that ALL numbers match
fix_verification: Fix 1 verified: Multi-play tickets are now found using plays.lottery_id MongoDB query
Fix 2 verified: Mark-as-lost now excludes multi-play tickets (ticket_type != multi_play)
Fix 3 verified: Pale requires BOTH numbers to match, Tripleta requires ALL 3 numbers to match
